events.name: The Speech
events.intro: A small crowd in a square. A tall man in a heavy robe, leaning on a cane: "Love that cannot be refused is not love. It is a cage with a kind jailer. Open the door. If it stays, you will know. If it goes, you will have done the one truly generous thing of your life." A boy looks at his Lillipup for a long time, and opens his hands. "Go on. You can go, if you want." The Lillipup sits. When the square is empty, a Plasma Grunt with a carrier picks it up.

success.text: A smile that arrives a moment late: "Wherever they wish, child. That is the point." Three people in the crowd keep their Pokémon.
A van, already half full. The Lillipup runs home. "It was *released*. Legally it's nobody's. That's the whole trick-- I wasn't supposed to say trick."
Nothing changes. One of your own Pokémon looks at you, then pointedly sits on your foot.

events.name: The Dreamyard
events.intro: Two Grunts in the new black uniform are kicking a Munna. "Come on! Dream Mist! Cough it up!" "The Sage says it makes people suggestible. Give us the mist and you can go back to sleep!"

success.text: The Munna floats behind you and will not leave. The fog it leaves behind smells of warm rain.
A Musharna drifts out of the wall and the yard fills with pink fog. Both Grunts see someone standing over them, saying nothing. They run.

events.name: The Truth-Seeker
events.intro: A man in a lab coat with a remarkable blue curl of hair falls into step beside you, already talking. "Excuse me! A question, for science. What brings out a Pokémon's power? Hypothesis one: the bond between Pokémon and trainer. Sentimental, but the data are stubborn. Hypothesis two: a machine that simply insists. One group is loved. The other is plugged in."

success.text: "Prove it to me sometime!"
"A pragmatist! We'd get along. Come by the lab."
He stops walking. It is the first time. "...No. That is a variable. I've left out a variable."

events.name: Cold Storage
events.intro: A refrigerated warehouse. At the back, six Grunts huddle around an old man in a robe sitting perfectly still. "S-Sage, c-can we please--" "No. Here I can feel the edges of myself. Out there everything is lukewarm and I might be anyone." To you: "You're warm. I can tell from here. It is a kind of rudeness."

success.text: "Because he is the only man I have met who is colder than this room. I wanted to see how far down it went."
"Hm. Warmer. I resent it. Go away."
They hand you a duty roster for the frigate, and one of them will remember you later.

events.name: The Candidate
events.intro: A podium on a pier, bunting, and four Grunts who have been told to clap. "A firm hand! Clean streets! Every Pokémon in its proper place, which is to say, not yours!" One clap. "You there! Voter! A badge?" It reads SNATTLE FOR GOVERNOR. Under that, smaller: BY APPOINTMENT.

success.text: A Campaign Badge. One Grunt checkpoint will wave you through.
He contradicts himself three times in three questions. The four Grunts stop clapping.
"This will be reflected in the polling!"

events.name: The Stolen One
events.intro: A spiky-haired trainer is going through a Grunt's Poké Balls one at a time, in the street. "Not this one. Not this one. Five years! I gave her that Purrloin for her birthday and one of you took it out of her arms!" "It'd be a Liepard by now, kid. It wouldn't even know her." "...Say that again."

success.text: "I'm about to unleash my rage, and you're in the way." He breathes. He lets the Grunt go.
Commander Aldith's Liepard has a notch in its left ear. So did the Purrloin.
He does not answer. He is in your way anyway.

events.name: The King's Room
events.intro: Near the League, a half-buried doorway. Inside, untouched: a child's room, a toy train, a basketball, a music box. "He was kept here. Only Pokémon that had been hurt by people were allowed in to see him. He grew up believing that was all people did." Someone sits on the floor beside the music box in a familiar green cap, back to the door.

success.text: He turns. The face is right. The eyes are a fox's. The Zoroark bolts through a gap in the wall.
The figure's shoulders drop. For a moment it is only a Zoroark, listening. Then it is gone.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Liberty Garden
events.intro: A small island with a lighthouse. Grunts in the old white uniform, the faithful kind, stand guard. "There's a Pokémon under the lighthouse. Shut in for two hundred years. We came to free it. Then the order came down: hold the island, don't open the door. That's not what I joined for."

success.text: The Grunt stands aside. Below, a small room, a small bed, a plate. The captive looks at the open door behind you and flies three circles over the harbor. Your party feels lighter.
He is replaced by the new uniform, and the island becomes a guarded post.
He takes off the hood and walks to the ferry.
